title: Wavelet Lab
tagline: Build, prune, and reconstruct a Haar representation
hub_blurb: Keep or remove Haar coefficients, reconstruct signals and images, and compare visual quality with measured numerical error.
card_blurb: An interactive Haar-wavelet workspace: choose coefficients for an eight-value signal, then retain a counted budget for a grayscale reconstruction and inspect raw numerical error.
description: **Wavelet Lab** — a self-contained Haar-wavelet reconstruction workspace. Students edit an eight-value signal, select approximation/detail coefficients, and inspect the inverse reconstruction; then they retain a counted budget of largest-magnitude coefficients from three procedural 64 × 64 grayscale scenes and compare original, reconstruction, and absolute error. It teaches orthonormal energy, squared-error tradeoffs, and the limits of a coefficient budget without claiming denoising or file compression.
